figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Panels (a) local anatomy, (b) global layout, (c) synthetic domain variation and (d) unified pipeline. Schematic, not measured patient dynamics. Possible repeated left-upper-lobe label retained as an issue.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 2
figures_and_tables_checked.review: JEPA context encoder, target encoder, relation variable and predictor; no clinical control loop.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 3
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Relative crop/pixel/patch coordinate construction. Spatial displacement, not clinical time or probe actuation.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 4
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Local and global feature predictions rendered through auxiliary diffusion; held-out-image statement in caption. Qualitative, no reconstruction-error aggregate.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 5
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Selected artifact/lateral-marker suppression visualizations. Appendix B.2 on pages 13–14 clarifies renderer protocol.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 6
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Reference landmarks and correspondence heatmaps for aortic arch, right hilum, left ventricle and clavicle; qualitative, rescaled display.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 7
figures_and_tables_checked.review: VinDr AUROC (%) versus 1%, 10% and 100% training data. Exact values appear in Table 5; label fractions are not temporal horizons.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 8
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Four selected SIIM mask-comparison examples for MAE, Adam-v2, CheXWorld and ground truth; no per-case metrics or confidence maps.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Five classification benchmarks, all rows and footnotes considered. AUROC except RSNA accuracy. Rad-DINO explicitly reference-only; undefined ± and VinDr inconsistency retained.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 2
figures_and_tables_checked.review: SIIM/RSNA Dice and MedFMC 1/5/10-shot AUROC; all rows considered. RSNA box-derived targets and first-split MedFMC protocol established in Appendix A.1.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 3
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All seven ablation configurations considered using supplied visual notes plus prose. Local/global/domain tasks, both conditioning variables and unified objective distinguished.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 4
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Recall@1/3/5 for CheXWorld, without domain condition and random choice. Sixty-four synthetic candidates; supplement specifies 50 base images.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 5
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All cells considered. VinDr training-data fraction results corresponding to Figure 7; metric resolved as AUROC (%) through that cross-reference. Full-data ±0.12 differs from Table 1 ±0.13.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Material
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Integrated three-page supplement; printed pages 1–3.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix A. Datasets and Baselines
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Dataset/task/split descriptions and comparator summaries.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix A.1. Datasets
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All eight dataset entries considered, including image/study/patient units, available splits, five-seed MedFMC protocol and RSNA mask construction.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix A.2. Baselines
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Comparator summaries across page boundary; no cited capabilities inherited.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix B. Implementation Details
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Pretraining, analytical rendering/retrieval and fine-tuning configurations.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix B.1. Pre-training
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Data exclusions, architecture, optimization, local/global crop settings and four augmentation ranges inspected.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix B.2. Analytical Experiments
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Auxiliary diffusion conditioning, renderer split, correspondence calculation and 64-candidate/50-image domain sensitivity protocol.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix B.3. Fine-tuning
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Pooling/head, SimpleFPN/U-Net, optimizer settings, 224×224 input, 10% validation allocation and five repetitions.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Appendix C. Numerical Results
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Figure 7 numerical counterpart, Table 5.

scope_choices: Automated API model review, not independent human verification, code execution, replication or clinical validation. This response is a skeptical second model pass over supplied full text and prior page/image review notes, not a separately commissioned independent assessment.

All 14 pages of supplied text were considered. Visual inspection coverage is inherited explicitly from the supplied page-image review notes; this response did not independently render or inspect raw PDF image pixels.

The PDF hash, source path, availability and page count are supplied metadata. No filesystem access, hash recomputation, repository retrieval, JSON Schema execution, semantic-validator execution, graph assembly or file saving was performed.
Feature assertions are deliberately empty as requested. This package is not a completed 128-feature assertion inventory or a validated canonical KG admission.

No persistent patient state, clinical temporal transition, acquisition-pose transition, clinical action regime, causal treatment-effect identification, model-coupled planner or clinical rollout is demonstrated by the inspected CheXWorld configuration.

Spatial crops and synthetic brightness/contrast/gamma/blur parameters must not be reclassified as probe motion or treatment interventions. The MLP called a policy network conditions embeddings; it does not select clinical actions.
L0 denotes WM-inspired representation evidence only. Core healthcare-WM membership is not established. No evolving WorldType is assigned merely from anatomy-bearing image inputs.

R2 is scoped to reported held-out actual-human-radiograph downstream evaluation. It is not inferred from synthetic retrieval candidates, qualitative realism, dataset expert annotations or source publication status.
Different benchmarks use separately adapted models. Their diversity does not establish R3 for a locked model or independent corroboration across studies.
NIH and CheXpert validation/test exclusions from pretraining are explicitly reported. A complete patient-level, duplicate-image and cross-dataset-overlap audit is not reported.

SIIM train/test allocation, MedFMC test sample size and shot-unit details, exact dataset release versions, CheXpert uncertain-label handling and several cohort eligibility details are not reported sufficiently.
The MIMIC description reports patient studies rather than unique patients. Approximate dataset totals and split counts are retained as stated and not summed into unique-patient totals.
Reported ± terms are undefined despite five repetitions being stated. No confidence level or formal significance test is reported for the extracted main comparisons.
VinDr full-data uncertainty differs between Table 1, 95.24±0.13, and Table 5, 95.24±0.12. Both are retained; no preferred value is selected.
The prose claims a 4.04-point VinDr advantage over Adam-v2, while Table 1 gives CheXWorld 95.24 and Adam-v2 91.46. The inconsistency is unresolved.
The claim of over 90 percent annotation-cost reduction is not a measured annotation-cost endpoint. The displayed experiments use 1%, 10% and 100% training-data conditions.
The domain-sensitivity experiment uses 64 synthetic candidates across 50 base images. Base-image dataset and exclusion from CheXWorld pretraining are not reported.

A deterministic embedding predictor, random data augmentation, latent relation variables and an auxiliary diffusion renderer do not demonstrate calibrated uncertainty or an epistemic/aleatoric decomposition.

RCDM renderings are produced by a separately trained diffusion model. Selected images do not establish pixel-perfect anatomy or pathology recovery, aggregate distributional realism, diagnostic safety or patient benefit.
Anatomical correspondence and artifact-suppression examples lack aggregate localization/pathology-preservation metrics and reader adjudication. Rescaled heatmaps are not calibrated probabilities.
RSNA segmentation targets are derived from bounding boxes. Their Dice results must not be interpreted as evaluation against pixel-accurate opacity contours.

Some baselines use different backbones, initialization, pretraining sources and compute. Some results are adopted from prior publications. Rad-DINO is explicitly reference-only and not a direct controlled comparator.
The paper states code and pretrained-model availability, but repository accessibility, checkpoint contents, license and reproducibility were not checked.

No prospective model use, expert study of generated outputs, measured patient benefit, operational monitoring, authorization or security/privacy effectiveness evaluation is reported. Missing evidence is not an assertion that all such mechanisms are absent.
Author scope caveat: the three modeled aspects may not encompass every dimension of medical understanding. No dedicated comprehensive limitations section was identified.
The stated Gaussian-blur kernel-size range, 0.05–2.0, has unresolved units/implementation semantics. A malformed supplementary sentence about the full-image input is not silently repaired.
Figure 1's repeated left-upper-lobe label is a possible illustration error. Bibliographic irregularities are not silently corrected, and cited systems' capabilities are not inherited.

Earlier page-review notes were generated in partial-page batches and contain local statements that other pages were unavailable. Those statements do not describe the present combined input; later supplement details resolve several earlier local unknowns.
